page_title: HAM 0-1 LEV | Hamburger SV v Bayer Leverkusen 04/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+8' Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) is in a good position inside the six-yard box to head a rebound home, but he is not precise enough and the ball flies away off the bar.
90+7' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
90+5' A yellow card for a tackle by Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen). Robin Braun doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90+4' Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches over the bar.
90+1' A long cross into the middle of the area is pounced on by Otto Stange (Hamburger), but his header curls narrowly wide of the right post.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Otto Stange (Hamburger) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
90' The game has come to an end for Ibrahim Maza. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Ezequiel Fernandez (Bayer Leverkusen).
89' The ball is cleared after Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
89' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
88' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

88' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence. Bayer Leverkusen force a corner. They send men into the box.
87' Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Bayer Leverkusen force their opponents to concede a corner.
86' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen), but the defence gets it clear.
85' Jarell Quansah (Bayer Leverkusen) and Robert Andrich try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
83' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
82' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
81' Merlin Polzin has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Albert Sambi Lokonga (Hamburger) replacing Ransford Konigsdorffer.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) comes onto the pitch for Montrell Culbreath.
78' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Fabio Vieira (Hamburger). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

78' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Daniel Heuer Fernandes anticipates the shot and makes a decent save.
73' 0 - 1 Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a well-taken defence-splitting low pass inside the box and scores! His great effort goes under the crossbar and into the net.
71' Here comes a substitution. Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) is brought on as a substitute for Martin Terrier.
70' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
68' The Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Robin Braun rules it out for a handball.
67' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) prepares to take a corner kick.
65' Merlin Polzin has decided to make a change. Jordan Torunarigha (Hamburger) replaces Warmed Omari.
65' Here comes a substitution. Damion Downs is given a rest as he is replaced by Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger).
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rayan Philippe leaves the pitch and Otto Stange (Hamburger) comes on.
64' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

63' Montrell Culbreath (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayer Leverkusen.
62' Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
61' Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
59' The ball is cleared after Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
55' William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

54' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Daniel Heuer Fernandes, who pulls off a comfortable save!
53' The corner from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared away by the defence.
53' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen). Bayer Leverkusen earn a corner.
50' Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
49' Montrell Culbreath (Bayer Leverkusen) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
48' Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
46' The whistle blows and Robin Braun starts the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) times his run well to meet a lofted cross near the penalty spot, but mistimes his header and sends the ball high over the bar.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' A lofted cross from Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
43' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner with a short pass.

43' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bayer Leverkusen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
40' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) has tested the patience of referee Robin Braun and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
40' Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
38' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
37' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
36' The game is interrupted now, Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
35' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
34' Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
33' Robin Braun couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) and blew his whistle.

32' Daniel Heuer Fernandes pulls off a fantastic save! Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the right post, but the effort is kept out.
32' It could have been a good chance to score! Jarell Quansah (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to release Christian Kofane with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
30' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post.
30' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Damion Downs (Hamburger), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
29' Bakery Jatta is being substituted because of an injury. Merlin Polzin sends William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) on the pitch.
28' Bakery Jatta (Hamburger) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
26' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Bakery Jatta (Hamburger). The ball is out of play. Hamburger SV will take a throw-in.
26' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
24' Montrell Culbreath (Bayer Leverkusen) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
24' A cross from Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
22' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to release Ibrahim Maza with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
22' Nicolai Remberg (Hamburger) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Robin Braun blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Bakery Jatta (Hamburger) sends a cross into the box, but Janis Blaswich comes off his line to gather the ball.
21' The cross fools the defence and leaves Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just wide of the right post.
20' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.

19' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Hamburger SV.
19' Bakery Jatta (Hamburger) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
17' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

16' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a powerful shot from mid-range which was stopped by one of the defenders.
16' Nicolai Remberg (Hamburger) brings an opponent down and Robin Braun interrupts the game. Bayer Leverkusen have a free kick from a promising distance.
13' Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) latches on to a lofted pass on the edge of the box and fires the ball towards goal! His strike crashes against the crossbar.
12' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Damion Downs (Hamburger), but the defence gets it clear.
11' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
9' Bakery Jatta (Hamburger) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
8' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Robin Braun saw the whole situation.

8' Montrell Culbreath (Bayer Leverkusen) gets free in the box and latches onto a good cross, but somehow he sends the ball narrowly wide of the right post from the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat.

7' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Ibrahim Maza was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
6' Montrell Culbreath (Bayer Leverkusen) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
3' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) and Jarell Quansah try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
2' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
2' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Hamburger SV will take the kick-off.
Robin Braun will officiate today.
